symptoms: Long, cigar-shaped or elliptical grayish-green to tan lesions (2-15 cm)
Dark fungal spore mat forming in lesion center during wet weather
Extensive blighting of upper canopy leaves
risk_factors: Moderate temperatures (18-27°C) with extended 6-18 hr leaf wetness periods
prevention: Plant corn hybrids with Ht-gene resistance
Rotate crops with non-grasses like soybean
recommended_actions: Apply foliar fungicides at silking if lesions appear on the third leaf below ear or higher
